summary:
Revoke the active public URL for a file. The underlying file remains
available through the authenticated content endpoint. Revoke is idempotent
— calling it on a file without an active public URL returns
`revoked: false` without an error.

RevokePublicUrlResponse.description: Response for revoking a public URL for a file.

id.description: The file ID whose public URL was revoked.

public_url.description: The full public URL that was revoked. Only present when `revoked` is `true`.

revoked.description:
Whether a public URL was actually revoked. `false` if the file had no
active public URL (no-op).
